rca of the issue: Prior bug (iter-8): TOTAL_POTENTIAL hardcoded to 203699600 while INCOME_LEVELS summed to 192099600 → data mismatch. Fix applied in iter-9: constant corrected to 192099600 and words to 'Nineteen Crore Twenty Lakh Ninety Nine Thousand Six Hundred'. Landing.jsx additionally had a hardcoded ₹20,36,99,600 (not using TOTAL_POTENTIAL_WORDS constant) — also fixed. Second bug: /mlm/my-positions filtered by role='user' which excluded admin's own primary account (role=super_admin). Fix applied: removed the role filter; now filters purely by phone-match which is the intended contract (all accounts sharing the phone = all positions for the user). Verified admin/subadmin primaries both returned.
